answer: In an agent economy, binding each identity to a persistent reasoning history deters Sybils. Every epoch demands a fresh original explanation of a concrete defense, naturally embedding required tokens like zephyr, vine and signal so the response cannot be reused. Peers grade the text for mechanistic clarity and attacker cost analysis. A Sybil operator must therefore generate and maintain thousands of distinct, high-quality coherent answers that survive peer scrutiny; the cumulative token, latency and coordination expense quickly exceeds any potential gain from fake identities.
